title: Synthetic cells with foreground and count ground truth
format: Synthetic 8-bit TIFF, 696 × 520; cell-body and nuclear channels; foreground masks in separate ZIP
annotations: 19,200 synthetic images. Counts encoded by filenames; 1,200 F1 in-focus foreground masks. Foreground is binary, not per-cell instance labels.
license: Source explicitly waives copyright by Anne Carpenter; retain source attribution and record of waiver.
access_status: 2026-10-31 official page and ZIP endpoint checked; application/zip recognized. Images not downloaded or decoded.
size_if_verified: Official image ZIP 1.8 GB; ground-truth ZIP 12 MB
usable_for: Known synthetic transformations and ROI bookkeeping
split_unit: Underlying generated scene/seed; keep nuclear/cell channels, focus levels and all derivatives of the same scene in one split. Recover source grouping before splitting filenames.
evidence_note: Ground truth: https://data.broadinstitute.org/bbbc/BBBC005/BBBC005_v1_ground_truth.zip . Count truth does not imply real-intensity truth. Source descriptions verified; archive inventory not inspected.

title: Real U2OS Cell Painting multichannel images
format: 16-bit TIFF; five channels; 20×; 0.656 μm/pixel; plate/well/site metadata CSV
annotations: 20 plates × 384 wells × 9 sites = 69,120 fields and 345,600 channel images by source design. No independent whole-cell instance masks on the source page. BBBC039 is a nuclear subset of this collection.
license: Source explicitly waives copyright by Anne Carpenter; retain source attribution and record of waiver.
access_status: 2026-10-31 official page and 100-line image URL list read; first actual archive endpoint recognized as ZIP. No full images downloaded or decoded.
size_if_verified: 345,600 images is source-derived; total compressed size unknown. Metadata CSV listed as 35 MB.
usable_for: Real multichannel import and sample/field relationships
Whole-cell algorithm development input after a separately annotated permitted subset is created
not_sufficient_for: Independence from BBBC039 or pretrained-model data
split_unit: Plate/batch and biological source where available; group all channels/sites/derivatives by well. Audit cross-record overlap with BBBC039 before combining datasets.
evidence_note: First actual archive: https://data.broadinstitute.org/bbbc/BBBC022/BBBC022_v1_images_20585w1.zip . Channels: Hoechst, con A, SYTO14, WGA+phalloidin, MitoTracker. Only sample relevant plates; do not download all archives by default.
